title: Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with?
summary: An analysis of why Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 model feels worse to work with compared to previous versions, exploring user experience discrepancies and potential reasons behind the perceived decline in performance or usability despite technical improvements.
problem_solved: Understanding why a newer AI model version feels less effective or pleasant to use despite being marketed as an improvement.
why_valuable: Provides community feedback and analysis on AI model user experience, helping developers understand model behavior changes and set appropriate expectations.
